instruction: Annotate all explicit METHOD, TASK, named DATASET mentions in exact abstract excerpt, with Unicode boundaries and every typed candidate relation. Use unresolved for ambiguity; never invent outside context.

contract.selectionBias: AI-selected clear examples, not independent or representative evaluation
contract.entities: Named models or distinctive algorithms/architectures/techniques as METHOD; explicit task descriptions as TASK; named datasets/benchmarks as DATASET. Generic models, tasks, datasets, URLs and pronouns excluded.
contract.coreference: Do not import entities or facts from outside the model-input excerpt.
contract.reviewPolicy: Same-session AI self-review only; not independent human annotation.
contract.sourceAbstracts: Original whole abstracts retained; excerpt offsets identify input boundaries and absolute entity positions.
contract.trainingPolicy: Separate abstract unit; not accepted silently by title-only training loader; strict token alignment preflight required.
